question: Find the area of a rhombus whose side is 25 cm and one of the diagonals is 30 cm?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In a **rhombus**, diagonals bisect each other at 90°. Half of the given diagonal is 15 cm.

Using the **Pythagorean triplet** (15, 20, 25), where 25 is the **hypotenuse** (side of rhombus), the other half-diagonal must be 20 cm.

Full length of the **second diagonal** d₂ = 20 × 2 = 40 cm.

**Area** = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂ = (1/2) × 30 × 40 = 600 cm².

**∴ The correct answer is 600 sq cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** **Side** (a) = 25 cm, **Diagonal 1** (d₁) = 30 cm.

**Formula Used:** 4 × a² = d₁² + d₂² and Area = (1/2) × d₁ × d₂.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/488b8347ee3151a9e766f1df90b7b1ac15ff1d54525714bae295370a2dcccde4.png] 

⇒ 4 × (25)² = (30)² + d₂²

⇒ 4 × 625 = 900 + d₂²

⇒ 2500 − 900 = d₂²

⇒ d₂² = 1600

⇒ d₂ = 40 cm

⇒ Area = (1/2) × 30 × 40 = 600 cm²

**∴ The correct answer is 600 sq cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Properties of a Rhombus

All sides are equal and opposite angles are equal. Diagonals bisect each other at **right angles** (90°).

Perimeter of Rhombus

The **perimeter** is given by the formula P = 4 × side.

Relation between Side and Diagonals

Side (a) = (1/2) √(d₁² + d₂²).</p
